scope: Fresh unaudited mechanics frontier after Batch 472.
selection_method: Selected six skill records with no registered current-evidence audit after excluding all prior current-evidence-audited records; prioritized a compact group spanning charge, evasive, grab, rush, and ultimate mechanics.

records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super from Nappa. Holding the input extends travel distance and increases power; full charge can break an opponent's guard. Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Nappa's Lesson 1 training as the acquisition endpoint and notes Bardock/Turles custom-partner availability after Partner Customization purchase.

100-Ki Other Super obtained from PQ97. The move behaves like Afterimage: incoming attacks pass through the afterimage and the user reappears elsewhere; successful evasion restores about 100 Stamina according to current skill documentation. Xenoverse 2 documentation also records Hit, Mira, Frost and Fu among users/skillset contexts.

500-Ki Strike Ultimate from Hit, obtainable through the Dragon Ball wish for an Ultimate Attack. A very short-range opening punch places the opponent into the time-skip sequence, after which a rapid barrage lands and the accumulated blows resolve together when the skip ends. The hit has grab/pseudo-grab properties once connected but can be blocked; exact frame data and universal damage scaling remain unresolved.

300-Ki Strike Ultimate learned through Gohan (Adult) and Videl training. A quick blue-energy high kick starts the sequence; on connection it continues through multiple kicks and ends with an energy-coated palm strike that supplies most of the damage and knocks the opponent away. The final hit can be vanished.

300-Stamina Strike Evasive from PQ69. Beerus plants himself and flicks the opponent with a single close-range forehead strike, dealing source-reported 10% damage and knocking the target away. Current documentation identifies it as a single-hit, close-range evasive.

200-Ki Strike Super from PQ130. The user grabs the opponent and slams them into the ground five times, with the final slam producing a hard knockdown; current skill documentation reports 15% total damage. The move has Super Armor when used by Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan), while Kale and Broly (DB Super) use the skill without that Broly-only armor property.

evidence_limits: Source-reported damage/stamina restoration values are not asserted as universal balance constants.
Exact startup/active/recovery frames, patch-independent scaling formulas, hidden interaction rules, and reward probabilities remain unresolved unless directly established.
Existing acquisition/provenance conflicts must be preserved rather than overwritten.
